name: vercel-ops-skills
description: An operating layer over the official Vercel plugin. Picks the right surface for a task (official skills vs the Vercel MCP server vs the CLI vs REST), enables and reads Web Analytics and Speed Insights end to end without the dashboard, knows which capabilities are plan-gated and that paid client work cannot run on the free tier, assembles project dashboard links from runtime-derived identity, covers Toolbar comment threads, bridges v0 output into an existing codebase, and records the silent failures in the Ship 2026 products upstream does not document yet.
